key_features: Duplicate prevention via semantic matching (ObjectiveBlockV2.tsx → UPDATE ObjectiveBlock.tsx)
SHA-256 manifest binding for tamper detection
Repository index building from discovery snapshots
Version suffix normalization (V2, v2, _v2, variant patterns)

verification_evidence.duplicate_prevention_test: ObjectiveBlockV2.tsx with existing ObjectiveBlock.tsx → UPDATE action with target_path='ObjectiveBlock.tsx'
verification_evidence.manifest_validation_test: Path traversal rejected, absolute paths rejected, REJECT actions filtered, allowed directories enforced
verification_evidence.hash_binding_test: Manifest seal computed and verified, tampering detected when manifest modified

functions: normalize_artifact_name: strips version suffixes and extensions
build_repository_index: extracts artifacts from snapshot evidence
find_semantic_match: matches candidates against repository using normalized names
determine_action: returns placement decision based on content and match
get_target_path: resolves final target path based on action
artifact_policy_module.duplicate_prevention_logic: Versioned filenames (ObjectiveBlockV2.tsx) map to base names (ObjectiveBlock) during normalization, preventing duplicate file creation

placement_manifest_integration.validation_added: validate_manifest() enforces path safety, version/family matching, no REJECT actions
placement_manifest_integration.repository_index_loading: _load_repository_index() loads snapshot and builds artifact index
placement_manifest_integration.manifest_sealing: _compute_manifest_seal() creates SHA-256 hash of all fields for tamper detection
